A graduate of Sparkman High School, Dale holds a bachelor’s degree from Athens State University and an EMT license from the University of Alabama in Huntsville. No stranger to hard work, Dale grew up working at his father’s country store. Dale’s father, Horace, launched a tour bus business taking North Alabama school and church groups on charter trips across the country. Working alongside his father, Dale’s efforts helped put him, his brother and sister through college. Education | Representative Dale Strong Skip to main content Image I remain committed to standing up for the rights of parents and the important role they play in their children’s education. Decisions related to education are best made at the state and local level - and with parents - who know their children best.    Returning control of education to the states will allow for more innovative and flexible approaches to better meet the unique needs of our children. Agriculture | Representative Dale Strong Skip to main content Image Agriculture is more than just an economic engine. It’s the very foundation of America’s stability and strength. Our farms, ranches, and food supply aren’t simply business interests; they feed our people and our independence.    For me, protecting the safety and integrity of America’s food and fiber supply isn’t a partisan issue—it’s common sense. Every American depends on a secure and resilient agricultural sector. Our nation’s prosperity, freedom, and future depend on it.   Agriculture is a pillar of our national defense – food security is national security.    My legislative work, including efforts like my bill, the “Protecting America’s Agricultural Land from Foreign Harm Act,” reflect this conviction. We must ensure our adversaries do not interfere with our food and fiber market by owning American agricultural land. These protections are critical. Please know that I will always defend the millions of American families who feed our country.    Issues Education Gun Rights National Defense Conservative Family Values Securing our Homeland Supporting Law Enforcement Veterans Agriculture Fiscal Responsibility 34.606974 -86.987372 34.7242159 -86.6004671 AL05

Strong to hold Fourth Annual Academy Day | Representative Dale Strong Skip to main content August 17, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON — Representative Dale W. Strong (AL-05) will host a Military Service and Academy Day on August 22 for high school students interested in attending a United States service academy.   "The fact that so many North Alabamians willingly answer the call to serve our nation in uniform speaks volumes of the patriotism held by our district’s youth,” said Representative Dale W. Strong. “It has been my honor to nominate over 150 young men and women to date to attend U.S. service academies and ensure students are prepared to take the next step in their path to leading the next generation of American servicemembers.”   Representative Strong’s fourth annual Academy Day will take place on Saturday, August 22 from 9:00 am – 12:00 pm at the Auburn University Research and Innovation Campus in Huntsville.     The event will include academy representatives from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy, Coast Guard Academy, and the Marine Merchant Academy; military preparatory schools; and representatives with collegiate ROTC and Alabama National Guard programs.   To attend a military service academy, students must meet certain eligibility requirements and receive a nomination from a Member of Congress, the Vice President, or the President. Students interested in receiving a nomination from Representative Strong are encouraged to attend.
